adjusted_volatile_messages: Create a reusable validator for an exact boolean flag.
composition_summary: Offline-design mode. Proposed one class-22 PythonCode draft named pc-check-flag (name/description/content only) that validates an exact boolean flag: reads inputs.get("flag") with a presence branch, treats only True and False as valid, returns {valid, flag} with flag null when invalid, uses a small helper and invokes it at module scope to assign result, and contains no imports, I/O, host calls, exceptions or coercion. The draft is an unapproved proposal; no submission, activation, tests or approval occurred. The host sink supports class 22 (name/description/content); class 21 drops step_descriptions/variants/dependency_registry, and classes 1-3/13 are unsupported there, so no Recipe/intent/settings proposals were emitted. Typed inputs remain a target interface, not guaranteed runtime support.

payload.name: pc-check-flag
payload.description: Validate an exact boolean flag from raw inputs and return a valid/flag result object. Reads inputs.get("flag") with a presence branch so missing and null are distinct invalid outcomes. Only the exact booleans True and False are valid; any other value (including non-boolean types) is invalid. Uses a small helper is_exact_flag and invokes it at module scope to assign result. Returns {valid: boolean, flag: original bool if valid else null}. No imports, I/O, host calls, exceptions or type coercion. Pure logic, zero host calls.
